mapper.select: WITH hist AS (SELECT s.student_id, sc.status_key, sh.updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.student_id ORDER BY sh.updated_at DESC) AS rn FROM erp_status_history sh JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = sh.student_id JOIN erp_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = sh.status_key WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND sh.updated_at <= #{monthEnd}), latest AS (SELECT student_id, status_key FROM hist WHERE rn = 1) SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_key = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_key = 'REST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rest_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_key = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS withdrawn_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_key = 'WAIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wait_count FROM latest;
